name: River Nene
text: The River Nene ( or ) flows through the counties of Northamptonshire, Cambridgeshire, Norfolk and Lincolnshire in eastern England, into The Wash in the North Sea. It flows largely northeast from its sources in Arbury Hill in Northamptonshire to its mouth at Lutton Marsh. The Nene and its tributaries drain an area of about 2,270 square kilometres (880 sq mi), with a population of 750,000.

depictions.name: River Nene
depictions.text: The River Nene is a river that flows on the east of Leicestershire, north of Cambridgeshire, and south of Lincolnshire.
